City of Chicago
                                                                     02021-3184
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 7/21/2021
Sponsor(s):                   Sigcho-Lopez (25)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 4-H bounded by S Allport
                              Stand W 18th St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                                                           City Council, July 19th, 2021
                                                 Committee on Zoning, Landmarks, & Building Standards


                                             ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing all of the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols

and indications on Map No. 4-H in the area bounded by


       South Allport Street; a line 100.00 feet south of and parallel to West 18th Street; the public alley
       next west of and parallel to South Allport Street; a line 125.00 feet south of and parallel to West
       18th Street

to those of Cl-3 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.




                                                                                BYRON SICGHO-LOPEZ

                                                                                       Alderman 25th Ward
